name: When should I consider adding a bathroom to my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider adding a bathroom to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider adding a bathroom if your current home struggles to accommodate your family's needs, such as during busy mornings or when hosting guests. It's also a valuable investment for increasing home comfort and resale value, particularly if you have fewer bathrooms than bedrooms. If your family is growing or you plan to age in place, an additional accessible bathroom can significantly improve daily living. An added bathroom provides convenience and can boost your property's market appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider adding a bathroom if your home lacks sufficient facilities for your family or guests, or to increase your property's value and comfort.
